name: crimson-cauldron-r5-pallets
description: PROBE ROUTE (draft, not for S-rank runs): Crimson Cauldron room 5 (Bog) pallet bridge with the carry-place step. Places 5 MovablePlatform pallets from the spawn stack toward the arena entry and logs where each settles.
notes: PROBE. Purpose: measure live where a dropped [FloatingPalletPlatform] settles over the lava (mario-route carry-place result=... settle=(x,y,z) top=Y) and whether native SM64 hops between them work. Nothing here is verified live; expect to edit the points after the first run.

Rules: vanilla quest content; native SM64 input only. Pallets are RecRoom.Tools.MovablePlatform tools, carried through the original pickup/release path (accepted default 'carrying movable boxes or driftwood to build steps', mario-base-form.md). The original refuses a pickup while anyone stands on the pallet (CustomToolPickupCondition); carry-place then ends 'refused' and never bypasses it.

Geometry (remaining-quests-plan.md 'Crimson Cauldron r5 (Bog)'): spawn stack x -137..-132 z -81..-78 (8 pallets incl. (10) lying in the lava); lava crossing from (-124.7,-30.25,-81.0) to the arena entry (-121.4,-30.34,-93.2); lava killzone level49:15658 box top y -31.1.

Plan: pallet 1 at (-125.50,-82.50) from the shore; pallets 2-5 on the straight line to the arena entry at a 2.3 m pitch: (-125.50,-82.50) (-124.68,-84.65) (-123.85,-86.80) (-123.03,-88.94) (-122.21,-91.09); the arena entry is 2.26 m beyond the last pallet. Hops use the native jump (hold jump while carrying); jump kinds are exempt from MarioGuard, every walk/carry is guarded (the guard's killzone test now uses the original foot sphere, so a pallet top 0.16 m above the lava killzone counts as ground).

Known risks to measure: (1) an SM64 drop puts the pallet only ~0.45 m in front of Mario (HOLP), so from the far edge of pallet k the next one lands about half a pallet + 0.45 m ahead, not 2.3 m: read placeErr= and adjust the plan (more pallets / shorter pitch); (2) hold-jump distance while carrying; (3) pallets drifting or tipping when landed on; (4) the line may pass the low [SpikedFence] / blocker Cube (3) (west of them per the plan).
